SELECT g.*, c.category_name, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(s.quantity), 0) FROM biz_stock s WHERE s.goods_id = g.id) as total_stock FROM biz_goods g LEFT JOIN biz_category c ON g.category_id = c.id WHERE g.deleted = 0
AND g.goods_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{goodsCode}, '%')
AND g.goods_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{goodsName}, '%')
AND g.category_id = #{categoryId}
ORDER BY g.create_time DESC
